title: Normalize Protocol Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize protocol/plugin/rs/lib.rs (and any colocated protocol/** fixtures/manifests) to the repo-wide Consistency Contract: C1 app-struct naming, C2/C3 region format+canonical order, C4 layout (single-app crate stays flat), C5 SDK-only mechanisms (adopt semio_framework_plugin's Terminology app_labels!/resolve_labels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt and Testkit testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge in place of this crate's local hand-rolled copies), C6 no cross-app plugin deps. This crate is the reference shape other crates converge to (protocol/plugin/rs/lib.rs), so this is expected to be light: verify PanelKit doesn't apply (no panels/tree_item usage), migrate Terminology + CommandLabels + app_labels() construction onto the SDK primitives, migrate the 3 generic test scaffolds (meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry + undo-redo round trip + two-instance convergence) onto semio_framework_plugin::testkit, verify .resource_kind(...) presence/absence is correct for this non-media BlockList app, fix region naming/order.
summary: Normalized protocol/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract. This crate was already the reference shape (C1 struct naming already correct, region skeleton already present, no cross-app deps, no local PanelKit tree_item usage), so the pass focused on adopting the newer Terminology and Testkit SDK primitives that landed in framework/plugin/rs after this crate was first written, plus fixing region ordering/naming. Changes: (1) Terminology — replaced hand-rolled `ProtocolPlayLabels` struct + `PROTOCOL_PLAY_LABELS_EN`/`_DE` consts + `protocol_play_labels()` resolver with `semio_framework_plugin::app_labels!` + `resolve_labels::<ProtocolPlayLabels>`; replaced the `(id,en,de)`-map builder body of `protocol_play_action_labels` with `localized_label_map`; deleted the always-empty `protocol_play_utility_labels` (no utilities declared, so simply omitted from the builder chain); replaced the manual `AppLabelsOverlay { .. }` struct literal in `app_labels()` with the `AppLabelsOverlayExt` fluent builder (`.window_kind_label/.mode_label/.action_labels/.action_arg_label`). (2) Testkit — deleted the local `meta()`/`new_app()`/`new_app_with_registry()` scaffolding and migrated all tests onto `semio_framework_plugin::testkit::{meta, new_app, new_app_with_registry}`; migrated `undo_redo_round_trip_through_the_wrapper` onto `testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip`; migrated `two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits_via_backbone` onto `testkit::assert_two_instances_converge` (probe = `(steps.len(), blocks[0].blocks.len())` tuple, matching the framework docstring's stated intent to retire this exact test as the "original, app-specific version"). All other tests and all business/handle_action logic left byte-for-byte untouched. (3) Regions — renamed `🔖App`->`🔖ProtocolPlayApp`, `🔖Builder`->`🔖Render` (kept `default_block`, a genuine document-mutation helper, in a new `🔖DocumentHelpers` region instead), fixed `🧪Tests` (was already correct), reordered to the canonical Constants->DocumentHelpers->Terminology->CommandLabels->Render->App->Manifest->Tests sequence; `🔖Manifest` now correctly scopes only `create_protocol_play_app`/`protocol_play_bundle`/`plugin_exports!` (previously nested inside the App region). (4) Verified C1 (struct already `ProtocolPlayApp` for app id `protocol-play`, no rename needed), C4 (single-app crate, stays flat, no mod wrapping), C6 (Cargo.toml deps are only the protocol domain crate + framework-plugin + vcs + serde — no cross-app plugin deps), and PanelKit (crate has zero tree_item/panel usage — BlockList surface only — so PanelKit adoption step does not apply). Verified .resource_kind(...) is correctly absent: this is a non-media BlockList app (no MediaExport/MediaImport, no OS-exportable mesh/brep format), matching the same pattern as the other legitimately-exempt non-media crates (fem, architect, mathematical, reasoning/mindmap, s) — not missing work from the Wave-1 pass.
